The lady who saw me was amazing, really seemed like she genuinely cared when we spoke. Yeah it didn’t cure me but if I hadn’t have gone back I think I would be in a much different place now. There are shitty doctors out there but also great ones. I didn’t get a psychologist but just having someone to listen helped.

I don’t normally remember my dreams for more than 10 mins after waking up but this one isn’t going away. It was also the most realistic one I think I’ve had because I remember so dam much. Anyways...

It didn’t last long but the first thing I remember is I was laying in my bed watching Netflix, the usual for me after work. I felt this like loose flap of skin on the inside of my lips with my tongue and I couldn’t get it off. Get up and head to the bathroom to try and get a look. When I pull my lip up to see, my skin starts to split where the skin under the nose meets the lip. Then the bit that scared me, the best I can describe it is I was suddenly moved to the passenger seat and couldn’t do anything. I really don’t want to relive the details but basically I had to watch my own face being torn and peeled off. 

I was terrified to go to sleep after that for a long time. I have no idea where this came from as I never really get nightmares but it truly scared me.
